shared_elements: animal in profile carved in low relief
quadruped with visible legs and tail
relief figures set on a flat rock/pillar face without ground line
justification: Both surfaces show animals rendered in shallow relief in strict profile, isolated against a blank stone field, including long-snouted/beaked creatures and quadrupeds, which gives a broadly comparable animal-relief repertoire. But B adds a distinctive structured programme absent in A — a row of repeated arch-and-figure motifs along the top, a banded register with pendant elements, a downward-facing predator over a small quadruped, and a large bird with a snake-like body below — whereas A shows only scattered, loosely placed animal outlines with no registers or hierarchical relationships.
